headline.size_rel: large, ~2-3 words per line, centered-left third of frame

caption.family_guess: same as headline, one running caption style (not per-word karaoke)
caption.size_rel: med-large, 3-5 word chunks, yellow fill/black stroke, no background chip

layout.host_pos: host fills frame edge-to-edge holding a physical printed paper up to camera; host stands/gestures, paper occupies center-right or is held overhead
layout.safe_zones: captions sit lower-third to mid-frame, avoid host's face; when host holds paper, text floats left of paper or below chin
layout.caption_pos: dynamic per-line placement near host's torso/left of held object, not fixed baseline

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: ~5-7 cuts (mostly caption-text swaps, few hard camera cuts; paper occasionally swapped for zoomed insert)
transitions: hard cut to paper close-up insert
hard cut to diagram/animation insert (neural net, transformer arch)

themeable: insert diagrams/images (paper photos, arch diagrams, logos)
